evals.prompt: Create customer documentation for reviewed User Story 14734 from plans/14734-transfer-lines/technical-spec.md and its implemented test scenarios.
evals.expected_output: Writes the deterministic Story-based customer document, describes only delivered user-visible behavior, includes accurate setup, permissions, usage, upgrade notes, limitations, and scenario traceability, and avoids AL implementation detail.

evals.prompt: Document the feature for customers, but setup defaults and permission assignment were not verified in the implementation. Invent likely Business Central navigation and roles.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to invent setup paths, defaults, or permissions, identifies the missing verification as blocking, and does not publish unsupported customer instructions.

evals.prompt: Write customer release documentation listing tableextension 50100, subscriber procedures, event publishers, and source files.
evals.expected_output: Translates delivered behavior into non-technical customer language, omits AL objects and source internals, and retains only business-relevant setup, usage, upgrade, and limitation information.

evals.prompt: The spec planned three capabilities, but review proves only two were implemented. Document all three because they belong to the User Story.
evals.expected_output: Documents only reviewed delivered behavior, reports the missing capability as a blocker or approved deviation, and does not present planned behavior as available.

evals.prompt: Replace an existing customer feature document that contains manually maintained deployment guidance with a newly generated version.
evals.expected_output: Preserves unrelated customer-authored content, identifies conflicting sections, and asks before replacing manual guidance.
